name: Docker Run Command Generator
description: Build a Docker run command from image, container, port, volume and environment-variable settings.
search_intent: Generate a docker run command without manually remembering command-line flags.
calculation: Build a docker run command from structured user inputs. Support common flags such as --name, -d, -p, --restart and optional environment variables and volume mounts. Properly quote or reject unsafe malformed input rather than concatenating arbitrary shell syntax. The tool only generates text and never executes commands.
limitations: The generated command is not executed by Navorika.
Users should review volume paths, ports, environment variables and image names before running the command.
Do not include passwords or sensitive secrets in examples or persistent URLs.
